articles.title: Aliko Dangote's Daughters Join Succession Plan
articles.summary: As Aliko Dangote prepares for Africa's largest IPO, he is breaking tradition by bringing his three daughters into the group's succession plan. Mariya, Halima, and Fatima have spent more than ten years working quietly behind the scenes of their father's multi-billion dollar conglomerate, which spans industries from cement and sugar to fertilizer and refined crude. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: U.S. court rules Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic was unlawful
articles.summary: A federal court in San Francisco has ruled that the Pentagon unlawfully classified Anthropic as a supply chain risk. The Department of Defense blacklisted the company in retaliation for its public criticism of government AI policy. The designation formally remains in place because a parallel case in Washington is still pending. The ruling still sends an important signal ahead of Anthropic's planned IPO this fall. The article U.S. court rules Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic was unlawful appeared first on The Decoder.
